title: Lighting project v0.10: staged power equipment, DC feeds, multi-channel zones

control_groups.description: Preserved source control intent and constraints, including MEP source zones. These are not the designed LV light zones or controller-output groups.

blocking_phases.description: Explicit phases blocked by this item. Omission conservatively means every phase; never infer phases from prose.

voltage.description: Numeric voltage attributes only. nominal_v, min_v and max_v are volts; AC/DC is stored separately as the applicable peer power-type field.

light_zone_id.description: Functional room/control zone served by this micro LV channel. One channel serves one zone; one zone may use many channels.

controller_id.description: Controller providing this channel's independently commanded output, when applicable.

controller_output.description: Physical controller output number. A populated controller/output pair is unique to one micro LV channel.

source_dimming_capability.description: Physical/source fixture capability. This is not the zone's applied dimming requirement.

source_cct_k.description: Optional correlated color temperature in kelvin. Null or omitted means unspecified; never zero.

source_cri.description: Optional color rendering index (CRI). Null or omitted means unspecified; never zero.

source_control_group_labels.description: Original MEP/source zone labels preserved as observations, never LV-zone IDs or inferred channel assignments.

dimming_capability.description: Inherent capability of the selected physical fixture/interface. A non-dimming zone may use a dimmable fixture; the unused capability does not alter voltage, AC/DC, CV/CC, current, driver architecture or wattage.

selected_cct_k.description: Optional correlated color temperature in kelvin. Null or omitted means unspecified; never zero.

selected_cri.description: Optional color rendering index (CRI). Null or omitted means unspecified; never zero.

mounting.description: Optional v0.3 fixture mounting context. Qualitative high mounting leaves numeric height null with a verification note.

space_labels.description: Retained source/display labels only. Canonical Space membership is defined by the Space ID-reference lists.

control_group_ids.description: Applicable source-intent/constraint IDs, distinct from this designed LV zone and its controller output. Confirm satisfaction or record conflicts during engineering review.

channel_ids.description: All microchannels serving this functional endpoint zone; an empty array is allowed for unallocated zones. Controller/output identity lives on each channel.

normal_schedule_intent.description: Preserved source schedule or operating requirement used to constrain the LV design; do not overwrite it with the proposed controller program.

control_group.description: A source design requirement with its original label, operating intent, and evidence. Referenced by our LV zones; source numbering does not assign hardware.

area_basis.description: Estimated area stays an estimate and must be reviewed when a code threshold could change the outcome.

source_room_type.description: Observed plan use or everyday room type; preserve separately from code classifications.

building_code_space_type.description: Space function selected for building-code analysis, independently evidenced; do not infer it from energy classification.

energy_code_space_type.description: Space function selected for energy-code control and lighting analysis, e.g. enclosed_office or open_office.

has_daylight_zone.description: Geometric daylight zone presence; distinct from whether daylight-responsive controls are required.

building_code_occupancy_group.description: Building-code occupancy group, distinct from Building Code Space Type and Energy Code Space Type. Unknown remains null.

level.description: Occupied/served floor, independent of fixture source sheet or mounting height. Null for a described multi-level Space.

inventory_only.description: Explicit unlit service-void/chase inventory entry. Requires description and empty light/zone lists. Not an energy-code exemption.

space.description: Room or bounded area. References existing lights and zones; does not duplicate their objects or editable fixture counts.

description: v0.8 plus bundle_routes derived from authoritative flat records. Installed lengths and electrical routing suitability remain unvalidated.
